# INTEGRATION_SPEC.md — API Contract Between Agents

**Generated by**: Agent A (Claude Code)
**Date**: 2026-04-21
**Purpose**: Defines the exact interfaces, import paths, and data shapes that both agents use.
**Audience**: Agent A (Claude Code) and Agent B (Codex) — both must follow this contract.

---

## 1. Module Imports

All agents import from these canonical paths. Do not use relative imports across agent boundaries.

```typescript
// ── Vault data (Agent A owns — read-only) ─────────────────────────
import {
  ROLE_META,           // Record<Role, RoleMeta>
  ALL_SCREENS,         // Record<Role, Record<string, RoleScreen>>
  ALL_TABS,            // Record<Role, RoleTab[]>
  loadVault,           // () => Promise<VaultData>
  getRoutePath,        // (role: Role, screenKey: string) => string
  screenKeyToRoute,    // (key: string) => string
  getRoleMeta,         // (role: Role) => RoleMeta
  getTabsForRole,      // (role: Role) => RoleTab[]
  getScreensForRole,   // (role: Role) => Record<string, RoleScreen>
  getScreensByTab,     // (role: Role, tab: string) => RoleScreen[]
  getAuthScreens,      // (role: Role) => RoleScreen[]
  getVaultStats,       // () => VaultStats
} from '@/lib/vault';

// ── Domain types (Agent A owns — read-only) ───────────────────────
import type {
  Customer, Restaurant, Agent, Admin,
  Order, DeliverySession,
  SupportTicket, FraudAlert,
  WalletTransaction, Payout,
  TrustScore, TrustFactor,
  MenuItem, Address, GpsPing,
  ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse,
} from '@/types';

// ── Layout components (Agent A owns — use as-is) ──────────────────
import { RoleLayout } from '@/components/layout';
import { PageWrapper } from '@/components/layout';
```

---

## 2. RoleLayout Interface

```typescript
// src/components/layout/RoleLayout.tsx

interface RoleLayoutProps {
  role: Role;                    // 'customer' | 'partner' | 'agent' | 'admin'
  meta: RoleMeta;               // { label, subtitle, icon, color, gradient }
  tabs: RoleTab[];              // [{ key, label, icon }, ...]
  screens: Record<string, RoleScreen>;  // { screenKey: { filename, tab, label, order } }
  children: React.ReactNode;
}
```

Agent B must use `RoleLayout` as the outer wrapper for every role page. Do not modify `RoleLayout` — if changes are needed, propose them via this spec.

---

## 3. Screen Key Convention

- Screen keys are defined in `source_flowConfig.js`
- Route segments use kebab-case: `auth_login` → `auth-login`
- File names: `page.tsx` (Next.js App Router convention)
- Route path: `/${role}/${screenKey.replace(/_/g, '-')}`

```typescript
// Example: Customer auth_login screen
// File:   src/app/customer/auth_login/page.tsx
// Route:  /customer/auth-login
// Screen key: auth_login
// Label: "Login"
// Tab: null (auth screen)
```

---

## 4. API Route Contract

All API routes return `ApiResponse<T>`:

```typescript
interface ApiResponse<T> {
  success: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: {
    code: string;      // e.g. 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 'VALIDATION_ERROR'
    message: string;   // Human-readable
    details?: any;
  };
}
```

### Endpoint Registry

| Method | Path | Handler | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|---------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/customers` | customers/route.ts | — | List/search customers |
| POST | `/api/customers` | customers/route.ts | — | Create customer |
| GET | `/api/customers/[id]` | customers/[id]/route.ts | — | Get customer |
| GET | `/api/restaurants` | restaurants/route.ts | — | List restaurants |
| POST | `/api/restaurants` | restaurants/route.ts | — | Create restaurant |
| GET | `/api/orders` | orders/route.ts | customer | List orders |
| POST | `/api/orders` | orders/route.ts | customer | Place order |
| GET | `/api/orders/[id]` | orders/[id]/route.ts | customer/agent | Get order detail |
| POST | `/api/delivery/assign` | delivery/assign/route.ts | system | Assign agent |
| POST | `/api/auth` | auth/route.ts | — | Send OTP |
| POST | `/api/auth/verify` | auth/verify/route.ts | — | Verify OTP |
| GET | `/api/wallet` | wallet/route.ts | user | Get wallet |
| POST | `/api/wallet` | wallet/route.ts | user | Create transaction |
| GET | `/api/tickets` | tickets/route.ts | customer | List tickets |
| POST | `/api/tickets` | tickets/route.ts | customer | Create ticket |
| POST | `/api/admin/refund` | admin/refund/route.ts | admin | Issue refund |

## 8. Handoff Protocol

When Agent B finishes a page component:

1. File is at `src/app/[role]/[screen]/page.tsx`
2. Component must use `RoleLayout` wrapper (from role `layout.tsx`)
3. Import domain types from `@/types`
4. Import vault data from `@/lib/vault` if needed
5. Use CSS classes from `tokens.css` (`.glass-card`, `.glass-button`, `.page-wrapper`)
6. Use role brand color via CSS variable: `style={{ color: meta.color }}`
